issues: 侧栏/顶栏是手绘灰条骨架，和卡片质感不一致
远层用 brightness 压暗，把白卡压成脏灰色
底板 2px 灰边、背景死平灰，炸开后底板空无一物
悬停 30 帧机位完全静止，层间深度只能靠大小猜
顶栏炸开后出画，构图偏右
changes: 八层都改为同一张 FakeDashboard 的真实切块（按原网格坐标裁切），合体时严丝合缝拼回原页
底板露出各构件的虚线插槽，整页加 14px 厚度板 + 56 级软阴影；每层浮起后带厚度边、顶沿受光与发丝线
深度压暗改为冷色相遮罩（≤28%，不再脏灰），底板压暗同样带色相
机位：开场 34f 缓带入倾角，悬停期慢摇 rotateY 再 -6°、俯角收 2.5° 读出层间视差，合体前摇回；悬停时略拉远并下移，近层不出画
背景换 Backdrop 柔光底 + 一抹靛色余光 + 颗粒；补导出 EXPLODED_VIEW_DURATION=150
issuesEn: Sidebar and topbar were hand-drawn grey skeleton bars that didn't match the cards
Far layers were darkened with brightness(), turning white cards a dirty grey
2px grey border on the base, a flat grey background, and an empty base once exploded
The camera sat dead still through the 30f hover, so depth could only be guessed from size
The topbar left the frame when exploded, and the composition leaned right
changesEn: All eight layers are real slices of one FakeDashboard cut at the original grid coordinates, so they reassemble seamlessly
The base shows dashed sockets for each part; the page gets a 14px thickness slab with an elevation-56 soft shadow; lifted layers get an edge, a lit top rim and a hairline
Depth darkening is now a cool-tinted overlay (≤28%, no muddy grey); the base dim is tinted too

Camera eases into the tilt over 34f, then drifts rotateY another -6° and pitch -2.5° during the hover for parallax, returning before assembly; it pulls back and drops slightly so near layers stay in frame
Backdrop soft light with a faint indigo tint and grain; exported EXPLODED_VIEW_DURATION=150
